content: .NET 10 Blazor WASM: response streaming enabled by default (BrowserHttpReadStream, no sync reads; opt-out WasmEnableStreamingResponse=false or SetBrowserResponseStreamingEnabled(false)). .NET<=9 required SetBrowserResponseStreamingEnabled(true). In all versions SendAsync must use HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead or HttpClient buffers the whole body. Request streaming needs HTTP/2+HTTPS. Source: learn.microsoft.com aspnet/core/blazor/call-web-api (updated 2026-10-13).
